messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Further to Northbank's agreement in principle, I attach our draft standstill and forbearance agreement. Key points: standstill to 30 April 2026, weekly 13-week cashflow, IBR by 20 March, and the usual reservation of rights. Grateful for your turn.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Broadly fine. Two points from the Bank: the standstill fee should be 120,000 (not 100,000), and we want the standstill to fall away automatically on any new event of default. Both reflected in our mark-up which I'll send separately. If agreed we can sign today.

Alistair
